def add(a, b)
  a + b
end

puts add(2, 3)

def find_user(id)
  return nil if id <= 0
  "user-#{id}"
end

def group_by(items)
  items.each_with_object(Hash.new { |h, k| h[k] = [] }) do |item, memo|
    memo[yield(item)] << item
  end
end

def retry_call(attempts: 3)
  last_error = nil
  attempts.times do
    begin
      return yield
    rescue StandardError => e
      last_error = e
    end
  end
  raise last_error
end

module Enumerable
  def map_compact
    each_with_object([]) do |item, memo|
      value = yield(item)
      memo << value unless value.nil?
    end
  end
end
